title: Card
description: One printing of a card, as every endpoint that returns full cards serializes it (decks, precons, batch lookup, tokens). Each face of a multi-face card is nested under faces.

card_uuid.description: The printing (mtgjson uuid) of the front face.

oracle_id.description: Scryfall oracle id, the same for every printing of a card. Match cards on this, not card_uuid.

name.description: Full name. Multi-face cards join the face names with ' // '.

layout.description: Scryfall/mtgjson layout: normal, transform, modal_dfc, adventure, split, flip, meld, saga, token, ...

is_token.description: Use this rather than looking for Token in faces[].types.

commander_legality.description: null when the card has no commander legality at all (tokens, Un-cards).

edhrec_rank.description: null for cards EDHREC doesn't rank.

faces.description: Ordered by side (a, b, ...). A single-faced card has one face, side a. Transform/MDFC: a front, b back. Adventure: a creature, b adventure. Split/aftermath: one face per half in printed order. Flip: a unflipped, b flipped. Meld: a front card has its own face (a) and the melded permanent (b); the melded permanent alone has one face, b.

image.description: Scryfall CDN URL, or null when missing or the art isn't out yet. The client shows its own fallback.

mana_cost.description: Brace notation: {2}{W}{U/P}{X}. null when the face has no mana cost (lands, most back faces).

mana_value.description: Stored once per card, so every face of a split or adventure card has the whole card's value.

types.description: In type-line order. A token's types include Token.

power.description: A string because of values like * and 1+*. null when the face has none.

toughness.description: A string because of values like * and 1+*. null when the face has none.

loyalty.description: Starting loyalty. A string because of values like X.

images.description: The halves of a split, adventure or flip card share one image.
